tagline: Docs, tutorials and mods for the OpenVoxel ModLoader (client + server)
mods.install: Client mods: copy the JAR into modloader-client/instance/mods. Server plugins: copy into modloader-server/mods.
footer: OpenVoxel ModLoader is a community project. Not affiliated with open-voxel.net.
home.version: Stable: ModLoader 1.0.0 for OpenVoxel 0.0.8 (launcher version 0.0.8-Debug). Beta: 1.1.0-pre1. Windows & Linux.
home.client.title: Client
home.client.text: Play OpenVoxel with Minecraft-style menus, Survival/Creative, crafting, chests, skins, chat colors and mods — without touching the game.
home.client.steps: Unzip next to OpenVoxelLauncher.exe (or set OPENVOXEL_HOME).
In the launcher select version 0.0.8-Debug and press PLAY.
home.client.contains: ZIP contains: the loader jar, launch scripts for Windows/Linux and the instance folders (mods, config, lang, resourcepacks, sounds, music).
home.server.title: Server
home.server.text: Run the official dedicated server with an interactive console, colored chat/commands and plugins from the mods/ folder.
home.server.steps: Download openvoxel-server-0.0.8-SNAPSHOT.jar from open-voxel.net into server/openvoxel-server.jar.
home.server.contains: ZIP contains: the core plugin jar, start scripts for Windows/Linux, server.properties.yml and the mods/, plugins/, server/ folders.
home.features.title: What you get

home.features.items.title: Survival & Creative
home.features.items.text: Hunger, armor, tools with mining times, item drops, fall damage; creative flight and a tabbed creative inventory.

home.features.items.title: Crafting
home.features.items.text: 2x2 grid, crafting table, chests and beds; recipes for tools, armor, torches, slabs, stairs… mods can add more.

home.features.items.title: Skins & cosmetics
home.features.items.text: Minecraft 64x64 / 64x32 / 128x128 skins with both layers, Steve/Alex, capes and elytra wings, skin upload to open-voxel.net.

home.features.items.title: Quality of life
home.features.items.text: F3 debug screen, rebindable controls, chat colors/history/Tab, resource packs, languages, sound packs and music.

home.features.items.title: Mod API
home.features.items.text: Commands, translations, config, items, recipes, HUD drawing and engine events through a small Java API.

home.features.items.title: Server plugins
home.features.items.text: Console, colors and utility commands on the official dedicated server; plugins use the official API.

home.whatsnewItems: Wall torches that need support and pop off like Minecraft
Mobs: pigs and zombies (client-side) with combat and drops
Recipe book in the inventory and crafting table
Creative inventory with icon tabs and stack counts
Tab player list and Minecraft-style command suggestions
Fix: menu buttons on maximized/fullscreen windows
home.beta.note: Pre-release for testing: it can have bugs. The server side of 1.1.0 (operators, tablist.yml, warps) comes with the final release.
